# clavis lease create

<p class="cli-lead">Create dynamic credentials</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis lease create CONFIG_ID [flags]
```

</div>

Issue credentials. The password is shown once.

## Examples

```sh
clavis lease create 4a1c… --ttl 1800
```

## Flags

<dl class="cli-flags">
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-ttl"><dt><code>--ttl int</code></dt><dd>lease TTL in seconds (default config TTL)</dd></div>
</dl>
